Paid portrait image generation retried POST after ambiguous network errors and did not persist the provider URL until the download succeeded. The runtime now journals the complete compiled request before one POST and saves the accepted URL before downloading. Download/cache/file failures recover from that same URL, including across run folders and independent processes. Unknown acceptance and missing legacy receipts prohibit automatic resubmission. Image result journals use private atomic writes, fsync, exact scope and request validation; dead locks may recover only with known acceptance. Studio supplies a stable journal root. Fault tests inject providers and make no live paid requests.

Final fact repair could lose a genuine model rejection when a later shot failed deterministic contract compilation. Recovery now rereads each complete source-bound review, verifies real passed/rejected evidence and separately recomputes unverified contract diagnostics. A diagnostic retains its unverified deterministic status and never supplies model approval. Changed scope, content, evidence, error, fallback or forged approval is refused. Each corrected candidate still requires fresh final fact review. The actual six-shot production completed through this path; regression fixtures use no live paid calls.
